messages:
harper: quick flag: onboarding demo logs are leaking tokens/emails when people follow quickstart with LOG_LEVEL=debug. i ran into this in a customer workshop.

mina: yikes. is this the same autoinit ordering thing where instrumentation captures attrs before our redactor middleware?

harper: yes but with a twist: our retry/batching layer re-emits events and sometimes swaps the request id on retries, so a single logical request can show multiple ids across logs. snippet: ```2027-04-12T10:02:11.100Z DEBUG rd.request_id=rd-x1 attempt=1 http.auth=Bearer%20eyJhb... user.email=dev@company.com
2027-04-12T10:02:11.300Z DEBUG rd.request_id=rd-x2 attempt=2 sdk.retry=true message=retrying```

jorge: two issues: (1) header/auth captured as structured attr at debug, (2) request id not preserved across retry attempts. batching/async stack sometimes clones context and assigns new ids.

kevin: for immediate mitigation we should: 1) change quickstart defaults to LOG_LEVEL=info 2) scrub seed data to `example.invalid` 3) add a CI smoke step that greps onboarding logs for email/token patterns and fails.

mina: agree. medium-term options: - expose `AUTOINIT_DELAY_MS` env so apps can let their middlewares mount before autoinit runs - or better, autoinit should register a lightweight pre-export log processor that redacts common PII and masks `Authorization` values when `AUTOINIT=true` and `ENVIRONMENT=dev`.

harper: i prefer the pre-export processor as a safe default for quickstarts. opt-out via `AUTOINIT_PII_GUARD=false`. docs should show how to opt into full exportless instrumentation.

jorge: regarding request ids: SDK retry layer should re-use the canonical `rd.request_id` header/attr instead of generating new ones. proposal: when creating attempts, if `rd.request_id` exists in context, propagate it; only create a new attempt id under `rd.attempt_id`. that keeps logs correlated.

kevin: +1. also standardize on header name `x-rd-request-id` and attribute `rd.request_id` across proxy config docs (nginx, envoy). will add mapping snippets for fluentd/stackdriver since transforms sometimes rename fields.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket INF-5201: "onboarding telemetry: token/email leakage + retry id fragmentation"  https://tracker.internal/INF-5201 :bug:

mina: implementation notes: the pre-export redact processor should be minimal (no heavy regex libs). simple heuristics: mask `Bearer ` prefix, replace email localparts with `[REDACTED]@example.invalid`, and run a small byte-scan for `@` in attribute strings. keep it reversible-unneeded (only in dev).

harper: i'll open a tiny PR for the quick fixes (LOG_LEVEL default + seed scrub + CI grep). mina can you draft the SDK change for AUTOINIT_DELAY and the pre-export processor? jorge can you handle retry id propagation change?

jorge: will do a small unit test that asserts `rd.request_id` is identical across attempts and `rd.attempt_id` changes. also add an integration test that runs the local-compose and fails if logs contain `Authorization:` or email regex.

kevin: docs task: add a short section in onboarding.md and SDK autoinit docs describing hook ordering, `AUTOINIT_DELAY_MS`, `AUTOINIT_PII_GUARD`, and canonical `rd.request_id` header. include nginx/envoy/fluentd snippets.

mina: one more catch: mobile autoinit path is tiny and currently skips log processors for size reasons. we should ship a micro redact shim for mobile quickstarts that does the same dev-mode masking without big deps. track as a follow-up.

harper: assign me for the quick PRs; mina for SDK changes; jorge for retry fix; kevin for docs. I'll link the PRs to INF-5201. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
